text: So that it does not listen to the voice of charmers, Or of the skillful enchanter casting [cunning] spells.
Before your cooking pots can feel the fire of thorns [burning under them as fuel], He will sweep them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning ones alike.
Men will say, "Surely there is a reward for the righteous; Surely there is a God who judges on the earth."
